version.author: Colton Bearden
version.changelog: First release: the cb console window with its Narrator and MIDI variation tabs, and the cb_narrator and cb_midi_variation actions that open it on their tab.

version.author: Colton Bearden
version.changelog: The bridge rejects a model answer that breaks its schema again: PowerShell 7.6's Test-Json reports a violation nested inside an object or array item without a message, and the check now fails closed.

version.author: Colton Bearden
version.changelog: Anthropic's Claude models beside Ollama. List them in your own bridge.config.json and store your API key with bridge/Set-BridgeKey.ps1, and the model dropdown offers them. The bridge picks the provider from the model, asks Claude through the Messages API with structured outputs, and checks the answer against the same schema as before. A Claude model picked with no key stored says so. Each job folder and bridge.log now record the provider, the tokens and an estimated cost, also shown in the console's log. Without a Claude entry nothing changes: the example config stays Ollama only.
